text:
Mira: Thinking about a compact webinar for next month — lightweight bench + customer story. Tentative title: 'InferBench Lite: pragmatic cost/latency wins for product teams'.
Sam: love it. audience should be product + infra engineers. keep it <45m.
Joel: can we do 20m talk (bench narrative) + 10m customer + 10m live q? that feels tight but good.
Mira: yes. 20/10/15 split works. need one internal speaker for the bench and one customer.
Sam: suggest bench speaker = Joel (you're up?) and invite Nisha from Acme for customer story. pinging @Joel for availability.
Joel: happy to do bench demo. will prep a short script showing 3 concrete levers: batching, caching, and model routing.
Karla: rehearsal windows next Tues/Thurs 10–12 and 16–18 PT. which slot works for all?
Mira: Thurs 10am PT for first rehearsal please. I'll run run-of-show.
Sam: snack question — do we need a prerecorded fallback? last webinar had audio flake.
Joel: yes let's prerecord the demo commands and a short 3-min fallback clip of the demo results. store in our google drive.
Karla: StageBot scheduled a rehearsal reminder 
StageBot: Rehearsal created: Thu 10:00 PT — attendees: Mira, Joel, Nisha (tentative), Sam, Karla. Link: https://drive.google.com/rec_abc123
Mira: draft abstract (short): 'Practical techniques to reduce per-token inference cost while preserving latency SLOs — real metrics from customer load tests and an ops-ready runbook.' thoughts?
Sam: tighten first sentence: "reduce per-token cost without sacrificing tail latency". then call out a live demo.
Mira: updated abstract done. will put in event page.
Joel: run-of-show draft (will keep to scriptable bullets):
```
0:00 - 0:30 Intro & goals (Mira)
0:30 - 5:00 Customer story (Nisha / Acme)
5:00 - 25:00 Bench narrative + live demo (Joel)
25:00 - 35:00 Ops runbook & deployment checklist (Mira)
35:00 - 45:00 Live Q&A + audience poll (All)
```
Karla: perfect. I'll create the presenter cue cards and a slide with fallback GIFs.
Mira: can Marketing own the event page copy + social CTAs? Sam can you draft CTAs?
Sam: on it. I'll share 3 headline variants by EOD today.
Joel: one ask for rehearsal — ensure bench uses stable model version and fallback to quantized variant. I'll add the exact commands.
Mira: note for ops: add a lightweight health-check snippet in the demo app. small code: `curl -sS https://api.redwood.example/health | jq .status`
Karla: recording + attendee follow-up template — I'll draft. we should capture top 3 action items from the demo as a downloadable checklist.
Mira: thanks all. next step: Sam to share CTAs, Joel to put demo commands in drive, Karla to finalize rehearsal invite. We'll reconvene at rehearsal. :thumbsup:
